metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2016 · Train to Busan
metas.description: While a zombie virus breaks out in South Korea, passengers struggle to survive on the train from Seoul to Busan.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2020 · #Alive
metas.description: The rapid spread of an unknown infection has left an entire city in ungovernable chaos, but one survivor remains alive in isolation. It is his story.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 2016 · Seoul Station
metas.description: Several groups of people try to survive a zombie pandemic that unleashes itself in downtown Seoul.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2004 · R-Point
metas.description: During the Vietnam War, a South Korean base receives a radio transmission from a missing squad, presumed dead, and sends a platoon to rescue the lost squad from the R-Point.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2026 · Hope
metas.description: A mysterious discovery is made on the outskirts of the remote harbor town. The residents find themselves in a desperate fight for survival against something they have never encountered before.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 2022 · Project Wolf Hunting
metas.description: Follows dangerous criminals on a cargo ship who are transported from the Philippines to South Korea, as they unleash a sinister force after an escape attempt leads to a riot.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2019 · The Divine Fury
metas.description: A world-champion MMA fighter suddenly discovers stigmata on his palms. His visit to a church leads to an unexpected exorcism with a priest. Together, they face a final showdown with Jisin, a sinister agent of evil.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 2018 · Monstrum
metas.description: Yoon Gyeom is a loyal subject of King Jung Jong of Joseon. He struggles to fight against a monster that threatens King Jung Jong's life and a group of people trying to depose King Jung Jong.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2024 · Handsome Guys
metas.description: Self-proclaimed tough guys 'Jae-pil' and 'Sang-gu' move into their dream European-style house. When unwanted visitors arrive, awakening an evil spirit hitherto sealed in the basement, a dark aura begins to envelop the house.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 2010 · Haunters
metas.description: Cho-In can control other people's minds when they are within his field of sight.Except one man.
